run_http2_test_server: run the HTTP2 test server on a specified base port with all test cases
start_test_servers: start one HTTP2 test server per test case on incrementing port numbers
create_H2Factory: create an H2Factory protocol factory for a specific HTTP2 test case
parse_arguments: parse command line arguments to get the base port for test servers
listen_endpoint: listen on a TCP endpoint for an HTTP2 test case with error handling
